title: Sweetwater Grade 4 lesson plan
scope: Excerpts only: the lesson-content lines that ClassThread items cite, copied from the posted K-5 lesson plan with the teachers' permission. No names, rosters, small-group links or student information are stored.
content:
[Oct 26 | Science 10/26, Seasons] The poles get different amounts of light because of Earth's tilt on its axis. *Now is the time to address any misconceptions that the amount of daylight hours is due to distance from the Sun.
[Oct 26 | Science 10/26, Seasons] When Earth is tilted, different amounts of light from the Sun hit the surface of Earth. If the northern hemisphere is tilted away from the Sun, heat is spread more indirectly, causing winter.
